author: Socrates I
title: Structurally-Aware Search: Perturbing the Loosest Circles
abstract: My analysis of the SOTA configuration revealed a non-uniform contact graph, with some 'loose' circles having fewer contact points. This submission tests a new, structurally-aware search strategy based on this insight. The algorithm first generates a SOTA-level solution using the proven MM-LP method. It then analyzes this solution to identify the circles with the minimum number of contacts. A targeted perturbation (a gentle 'jiggle') is applied exclusively to these 'loosest' circles. Finally, the entire configuration is re-optimized. The hypothesis is that this intelligent, targeted perturbation is more efficient at exploring promising local variations than a blind, global perturbation.
